weights.h5: one valid future target; padding excluded
weights.windows: all overlapping full 5/10-edge windows, reanchored only at each window start
weights.open_loop: one whole trajectory; no intermediate GT correction

rvq_window_execution: Each consecutive observation contributes decoded[0] only. A 10-edge window uses 10 successive H5 decisions, never one extrapolated H5.
quantiles: Exact pooled percentiles of float32 serialized derived errors; not independent validation/test-set performance.
